desc: Parse N, S, T and build mapping from each letter in S to the unique T letter it must become; validate uniqueness; return -1 on conflict.
Identify the set of letters that actually appear in S and need change (f[c] != c). For these, build adjacency between c and f[c].
Count connected components (undirected) over this set, tracking size and whether any node in the component is a self-mapped letter (f[c] == c).
Accumulate answer: for each component add size; if no self-mapped letter exists, add 1 extra.
Implement DSU-based solution in Python with solve() function and main guard.
